place.en: The hidden realm · The stone chamber

_split: 2026-10-31 (Hanli 10-28: 「故事里是4层圆满, 游戏里保持一致」 — the 层 matches the book wherever it states one): wm-kaikai's way on cut in two so each layer the 石室 states has its gate right before it. wm-kaikai waits on 三层圆满 before 「第二天晌午，他冲开了第四层」; this scene tells 老蔫's climb and fall (wm-kaikai's way on until 2026-10-31, word for word) and its way on waits on 四层圆满 before 「第三天天快亮…再吸半天，第五层的门槛也许便摸得着了」, then the doors. No board of its own: the 石室's hosted practice is the work (rules/gates.mjs entryGate leaves a room with practice alone).

setup.zh: 你埋在石室的土丘里，五行在身子里转着，长了一半的地还没长成。墙外头，老蔫脱了袄子，开始往崖上爬。
setup.en: You are buried in the mound in the stone chamber, the five phases turning in you, the half-grown ground not yet grown in. Outside the wall, Old Wilt has shed his jacket and starts to climb.

recap.zh: 你埋在息壤里，土一破，长了一半的地就是一块烂泥；你没有动。老蔫爬到第十九下，没扒住，掉进了凶崖。第三天天快亮，石室里的灵气还厚着。
recap.en: You were buried in the living soil; break the earth and the half-grown ground would be so much mud. You did not move. At the nineteenth handhold Old Wilt lost his grip and fell into the Cliff of Danger. Near dawn on the third day the qi in the chamber still lay thick.

story.zh:
小满埋在土里，土齐着胸口，两只手按在膝盖上，指甲掐进了肉里。他只要从土里站起来——土一破，那些须子便断在半路，长了一半的地，就是一块烂泥。那一圈五行在他身子里转着，转得又匀又快，他没有动。

墙外头，响起了一下一下往上爬的声音，指甲刮着石头，很慢，隔很久，一下；又隔很久，一下。小满数着。数到第十九下，那声音停了。

然后是一声惨叫，很长，很长，从崖上往下掉，掉过了那道石台，掉进了石台外头那一片黑里，越掉越远，越掉越细，细成一根线，断了。

隔了很久很久，底下传上来一声。很轻，像一滴水。

崖上一个声音也没有。墙里头，小满埋在土里，一动不动，那一圈五行还在他身子里转，他却觉得冷，冷得牙齿磕着牙齿。
story.en:
Xiaoman was buried in the earth up to his chest, both hands on his knees, his nails digging into his flesh. He had only to stand up out of the earth. But break the earth and those roots would snap halfway, and the half-grown ground would be a patch of mud. The round of the five phases turned in his body, even and fast. He didn't move.

Outside the wall came the sound of climbing, one pull at a time, fingernails scraping rock, very slow: a long gap, one; a long gap, one. Xiaoman counted. At nineteen, the sound stopped.

Then a scream, long, long, falling from the cliff, falling past the ledge, falling into the dark beyond the ledge, further and further, thinner and thinner, thin as a thread, and then it broke.

After a long, long time a sound came up from below. Very faint, like a drop of water.

Not a sound on the cliff. Inside the wall, Xiaoman sat buried in the earth without moving. The round of the five phases still turned in him, but he felt cold, so cold his teeth knocked together.

exits.means: near dawn of the third day draws the chamber's qi in once more, at the fourth layer's full (the stage quest); the ring slows, 银月 says enough, he lets the breath go and the mound cracks open

story.zh:
第三天天快亮，石室里的灵气还厚着。再吸半天，第五层的门槛也许便摸得着了。他便又吸了一口。这一口吸下去，他觉出不对来了：丹田里那一圈转，慢了，沉了，像灶膛里柴塞得太满，火闷住了，只冒烟，不起焰；他再吸，那灵气便在经脉里堵着，胀得他胸口发闷，太阳穴一跳一跳地疼。

一个很困的声音在他耳朵里道：「够了。」小满道：「还没够。再吸半天，就五层了。」那声音道：「……你娘给你起的名字，叫什么？」小满愣了一愣。他想起过年那天夜里，他娘拨着算盘，给他讲他这个名字：满了就要溢出来，溢出来就糟践了；饱了一点，还没满，还知道饿。知道饿，才知道别人也饿。他慢慢地，把那口还没吸完的气吐了出去。吐出去的那一刻，胸口一松，像从塞满的灶膛里抽出一根柴，风钻进去，火苗子「呼」地蹿了起来——那一圈又转了，转得轻快，匀匀的。石室里的灵气还厚厚地积着，他只舀走了浅浅的一层；剩下的，留给它自己。便在这时，隔着那面墙，崖壁上传来马小宝的声音，饿得又哑又低，却一个字一个字地钻进来：「……沈小满。你在里头喘气，我听得见。」

那座土丘「喀」地裂开了。他从土里爬出来，身后留下一个坐出来的窝。剩下的土，已经是寻常的土了；息壤，都长进了他身子里。他趴到墙角，把那道细泉喝了一口，甜得发腻。青石地上，掉了几粒土渣的地方，冒出了一根青芽。这一屋子里，只这一点绿。

他走到那面光溜溜的石壁跟前，石壁里照出一个人影，蓬着头，一脸的泥和血——那人影的皮肤底下，有光。金白的，青的，黑的，红的，黄的，五种颜色，一道一道，像五条小河，从心口流到手指尖，又流回来。杂灵根，那三个字，是执事拖长了调子念的。换了昨天，他该咧着嘴笑。这时候他只觉得嘴里发苦。他把那只赤铜葫芦掏出来握着，葫芦肚里一点一点温了起来——他五扇门里，有一扇是火。包袱里还剩一根萝卜，他啃了。
story.en:
Near dawn on the third day the spirit qi in the chamber was still thick. Half a day more of drawing it in, and he might touch the threshold of the fifth layer. So he drew another breath. As this breath went in, he felt something was wrong: the round in his dantian had gone slow and heavy, like a stove stuffed too full of wood so the fire chokes and only smokes and won't flame. He drew again, and the spirit qi jammed in his meridians, swelling until his chest was tight and his temples throbbed with pain.

A very sleepy voice said in his ear: "Enough." Xiaoman said: "Not enough yet. Half a day more and it's the fifth layer." The voice said: "...The name your mother gave you. What is it?" Xiaoman was taken aback. He remembered New Year's night, his mother clicking her abacus and telling him about his name: when a thing's full it spills over, and what spills is wasted; a little fed, not yet full, you still know hunger. Knowing hunger is how you know other people are hungry. Slowly, he let out the breath he hadn't finished drawing. As it went out, his chest eased, like pulling one stick out of a stuffed stove: air got in, and the flames leapt up with a *whoosh*. The round turned again, light and quick and even. The spirit qi lay thick in the chamber still; he'd only scooped off a shallow layer. The rest he left to itself. Just then, through the wall, came Ma Xiaobao's voice from the cliff, low and hoarse with hunger, but every word getting through: "...Shen Xiaoman. I can hear you breathing in there."

The mound of earth split open with a *crack*. He climbed out of it, leaving behind him a hollow where he'd sat. The earth that was left was ordinary earth now; the living soil had all grown into his body. He crawled to the corner and drank a mouthful from the thin spring, sweet to the point of cloying. On the bluestone floor, where a few crumbs of earth had fallen, a green shoot had come up. In the whole room, that was the only bit of green.

He went to the smooth stone wall, and in it was a reflection: tousled hair, a face covered with mud and blood. And under that reflection's skin there was light. Gold-white, green, black, red, yellow, five colours, streak by streak, like five little rivers flowing from the heart to the fingertips and back. *Mixed spirit root*: those words the steward had drawn out long. Yesterday he'd have grinned at this. Now there was only a bitter taste in his mouth. He took out the red-copper gourd and held it, and the belly of the gourd warmed little by little: of his five doors, one was fire. There was one radish left in his bundle. He ate it.

exits._doors: The page's moment after this exit (story.mjs node `doors`): the five doors open one by one, a seal and a line each, in ink — colour is for 银月's memories alone. On wm-xirang's swallow until 2026-10-20; moved here when the 息壤 paragraphs and 息壤 · 五门 came to this scene (the reading cap), so the card stands after 「那座土丘『喀』地裂开了。息壤，都长进了他身子里」, never before the soil is even scattered.

doors.zh: 第一扇，金。「铮」的一声——是爷爷那张弓的弦。
doors.en: The first, Metal. A twang — the string of Grandpa's bow.

doors.zh: 第二扇，木。吱吱呀呀，像黑松岭的松树，在没有风的夜里自己挪了一步。
doors.en: The second, Wood. Creak by creak, like the pines of Black Pine Ridge moving a step on a windless night.

doors.zh: 第三扇，水。一冷——是那一盆洗髓的水；冷过了，化成一条清河。
doors.en: The third, Water. A chill — the marrow-washing basin; then it melts into a clear river.

doors.zh: 第四扇，火。灶膛里的火。娘拨一拨柴：「打不过就跑，跑不丢人。」
doors.en: The fourth, Fire. The fire in the stove. Ma pokes the wood: "If you can't win, run. No shame in running."

doors.zh: 第五扇，土。一股锈味儿，越开越淡——底下，是开春翻开的新土。
doors.en: The fifth, Earth. A smell of rust, fainter as it opens — and underneath, new earth turned in spring.

exits._grant: 古五 (2026-10-02): the bead he closed his hand on in a crack below the wind shaft, climbing back with the knife in his teeth (wm-xirang's passage) — handed over here, a scene later, because wm-xirang's exit already grants the knife and a grant carries one item.
